title: Lilly pulls out of CNS portion of $960M RIPK1 inhibitor collab with Rigel
summary: Eli Lilly has pulled out of the central-nervous-system-focused portion of a $960 million biobucks deal centered on Rigel Pharmaceuticals’ receptor-interacting serine/threonine-protein kinase 1 inhibitors.
